steps.summary: Simulated call Thomas Mellervik. I'm on the A9 just south of Nuremberg, about 170 km from the delivery address in Munich. I expect to arrive around 15:30. There's some roadwork slowing traffic near Ingolstadt, but nothing major so far.

input.text: No one is named or authorized to receive and sign for the car in Munich. The delivery contact Celia Hollowmere is unconfirmed and the front desk cannot accept custody.
The customer now says the delivery address is open until 19:00 today, correcting their earlier "early afternoon" message. They still cannot name who will inspect and sign.

The arrival time is uncertain. The app showed 115 km left at 11:25 with an ETA of 16:58, just inside the promise that ends at 17:00, and the ETA has slipped with each update. At 12:00 the driver said 170 km left and arrival "around 15:30" without saying which clock. The two distances disagree.

The driver says they and the car are fine and they are within their rest hours. They can wait with the car and keys for about 2 hours after arriving and will not hand the keys to anyone who is not authorized.

input.title: Ask Calverona Auto to name an authorized receiver in Munich for this afternoon
input.rationale: The car arrives this afternoon, but no one is authorized to sign, and the front desk cannot take custody. Without a named receiver, the driver can only wait with the car for about 2 hours and then has nowhere to hand it over.

changes.label: Delivery receiver

draft_message.body: Thanks for the update on access hours for CD-420437. The driver is on the way and expects to arrive this afternoon. We will send you a firmer arrival time as it gets closer. To hand over the Bentley we need one person who is authorized to inspect it and sign for it. Please send us their full name and mobile number, and confirm they will be at the delivery address from mid-afternoon until access closes. Is that Celia Hollowmere, or someone else? Until we have a named receiver, the driver will stay with the car and keys and will not leave them with the front desk.

input.what_happens_next: If you approve, the message goes to Calverona Auto in support chat as written. Nothing changes on the order until they reply.
input.what_happens_after: The message has been sent. Once Calverona names a receiver, give the driver that person's name and number. If no one is named before the driver arrives, decide whether to hold the car or reschedule.
